# Le Quotidien d'Oran: search, news and AI discovery policy
User-agent: *
User-agent: Googlebot
User-agent: Googlebot-News
User-agent: Bingbot
User-agent: OAI-SearchBot
User-agent: ChatGPT-User
User-agent: GPTBot
User-agent: Google-Extended
Allow: /

# Public API responses used when crawlers render the React application
Allow: /api/articles
Allow: /api/categories
Allow: /api/settings/bootstrap
Allow: /api/image

# Private administration and internal API routes
Disallow: /manage-portal/
Disallow: /admin/
Disallow: /api/

# Discovery endpoints
Sitemap: https://lequotidien-oran.dz/sitemap.xml
Sitemap: https://lequotidien-oran.dz/news-sitemap.xml
